_doc: AUTOPILOT (Phase 059), test pack: the same shape as the bigville pack with smaller numbers, so a test town consults in a short run. Read by domains/autopilot.py, bigville/backends/autopilot.py and domains/autopilot_check.py. Every number is a test choice (APPROX), not a model of the Bigville town. routine_strength weights the traits in world/persona.json; max_quiet_ticks runs from 12 to 48 ticks; boundary_consult_share scales the routine-boundary consults; consult_triggers names the events that prompt a consult.
